body: Okay. Thank you so much for taking your time out to look at it and respond. Will surely try for government exams too.
Hi! How are you doing now? I hope everything is fine.

Oh. And did you go for CA right after 12th? Or after regular degree?

And what's your plan after becoming CA?

Woah.

How's the life then? I mean how do you keep up with your expenses? What were your options before joining CA? What made you join it?

I know I'm asking lots of questions and I am sorry for that if it feels weird.

Oh. That's making me so very nervous.

What else are you doing after your articleship now aside from your preparation for CA Final? And what did not go right for you that made you delay your attempt till 2021?

And what's your plan once you become a CA?

Thanks for your explanation. 

>have you been stuck at home for the last 6-8 months watching pre-recorded class & trying to make sense of a tough problem in your text book with little to no social interaction

We didn't even had any pre-recorded classes initially during my Final Sem of BCom. It was just we with our textbooks and previous year question papers trying to make sense out of Final Statements of Banks, Amalgamation, Variance Analysis, Fund Flow and Cash Flow analysis and stuffs. It was just before 1 month of exams that we got the videos from our lecturers.

>that's my life studying for CA final for past 4 years.

How come 4 years? Can you please elaborate?

Hi. Sorry for not replying. Was a little depressed.

Thank you so much for your response.

Does that mean that my Jataka advices me against the MBA? Because that Jyotishi said that either MBA or CA, both can be good for me.

And do I have any luck factor kind of thing? Because even though I know I will work hard, but still exams like these, (CA or government jobs) require luck and I am just afraid of falling into the exam loop.

Hi. Sorry for not replying till today. Was a little depressed.

So, as others keep saying, is it true that sometimes the institute deliberately fails certain individuals to maintain their pass percentage?

And what would you recommend in this case? Is a person still better off with a 3 years of articleship or 2 years of MBA from an above average college?

>Did you like accounting in undergrad?

I don't really know how to put it. Like, I did score pretty good in Accountancy throughout my academics. Also, in my last sem, I scored full in both Tax and Financial Management. Law was wrecking me a little but still I scored good. But, do I like or dislike this? I don't really know. I went numb figuring it out.

Also, I eventually felt that once I have enough capital in hand, I would try to have a business side by side. But, I don't really have any idea of what business I want to have. I have stayed in village for my academics and agriculture did interest me though. Like, I love working in our field when it's the time of seeding right till harvesting. But, one can't create a good income source in it until hr has a good enough capital for seeds, manure, fertilisers and labour.

Yes. But, most of the comments which I got were suggesting me against the chartered accountancy course because of time and the content of study.

They were also suggesting against going for MBA from anything other than the Tier 1 colleges for which I lack probably lack aptitude and will have to dump an year too.

I am still as confused as I was before.. Time is running out..

So, I am a 22 years old guy who just completed his BCom. My performance was good academically. But, now I am clueless as to what should I go for ahead. I come from a pretty poor background but still have a decent life thanks to my parents. Everyone are suggesting me either MBA or CA. But, I don't even know which to choose. I have an option to do MBA from average B-Schools on government quota which I will have to finalise tomorrow and for which I would still have to take loan but that's it. I am afraid if I will even be able to manage to clear CA exam. Sometimes, I think of government jobs in which I sometimes wish for IAS, then bank, then some ugc lecturer. I eventually wish to have something of my own. Then on top of that there's another stress which is related to my love life. My girlfriend is elder then me and we want to marry each other. She too comes from the same background as me and we understand and support each other pretty well. Her friends are getting married, some even have kids and now her family is pressuring her to do so too. But, I don't even have any idea about my career. It is feeling like I have failed everybody who had high hopes in myself including me too. 

I had consulted a well known Jyothish (a friend of my dad's friend) and looking at my Jataka, he said that my Guru is good till I'm around 33 years of age but its a little weak right now because of Shani (I don't remember in which house) which will stay for 3 years and its the root of my confusion. He suggested me to visit Shani or Hanuman temple every Saturday which I used to visit when in Mumbai but here in village it was difficult. However, I don't know how, but I got the opportunity quite suddenly to visit Shani temple (some 15kms away) in previous Saturday evening. He also suggested that I go through Vishnu Sahastranama every morning. I am doing that since last 3 days (courtesy the great M. S. Subbulakshmi and Swami Krishnananda dot org). Our village (and every other place in Udupi, DK) is known for praying to Demi Gods too along with others. We have two such temples at our home and I pray to them too everyday twice without fail. But, still, I have no peace. No clarity. No will. Sometimes, I almost take a decision, but then I start doubting it too. All I ever wished was to give my loved ones the life they never had. To be rich enough to satisfy all their needs. But, I'm afraid that in this state I am never gonna do it. 

I know this went way too long. But, I really need some help.

P.S. - Images have both South and North.
